_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% directional break rate over 7 days makes HOLD the statistically dominant call, and with ETF flows negative and stablecoins shrinking, there is no confirmed capital inflow signal to justify calling a directional break — the August 2024 analog is a setup, not a trigger, and the trigger (inflow recovery) has not fired.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst says HOLD (medium conviction), narrative implies UP (reversal rally). The split is real: analyst trusts the broken factor data over the pattern; narrative trusts the pattern over the factors. Trust weights lean analyst (7.67 vs 6.00), so HOLD wins.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive and stablecoin growth recovers above 45 — this is the analyst's own confirmation signal and it aligns with the narrative's accumulation thesis
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60k with funding flipping negative and VIX spiking above 20 — this kills both the analog and the structural case simultaneously
